name: Top Bar UI
description: TopBar DOM and interactions. Documents the menu bar structure with four hover-dropdown menus (File/View/Tools/Help), nested submenus (Terminal instances, Canvas grid, Zoom), action items, separators, a spacer, and the theme toggle button.

elements.menu_item: div.menu-item — top-level menu trigger (File, View, Tools, Help); hover opens dropdown
elements.menu_dropdown: div.menu-dropdown — dropdown panel inside a .menu-item, shown when parent has .open class
elements.menu_item_nested: div.menu-item-nested > span + span.arrow('▸') + div.menu-dropdown-nested — nested submenu trigger (Terminal, Canvas, Zoom)
elements.menu_dropdown_item: div.menu-dropdown-item — clickable action item; may have .is-disabled for inactive items
elements.menu_dropdown_separator: div.menu-dropdown-separator — visual separator between menu groups
elements.menu_check: span.menu-check('✓') — checkmark indicator for currently selected grid/zoom-lock option
elements.term_instance: div.menu-dropdown-item.term-instance[data-term-uuid][data-term-open] — dynamic terminal instance entry; .is-closed class when not open
elements.menu_spacer: div.menu-spacer — flex spacer between menu items and theme toggle button

interactions.name: open_menu
interactions.action: Cancel any pending close timer → close all open menus (remove .open from all .menu-item) → add .open class to hovered .menu-item

interactions.name: schedule_close
interactions.action: Set 300ms setTimeout that removes .open from all .menu-item; clearing previous timer if any
interactions.propagation: Hovering back into .menu-item or .menu-dropdown within 300ms calls cancelClose which clears the timer

interactions.name: click_outside
interactions.action: Remove .open from all .menu-item elements; handler is replaced on each render() via removeEventListener + addEventListener to prevent accumulation

interactions.name: grid_select
interactions.action: Stop propagation → read data-grid value → update this.gridStyle → fire onGridChange(value) → re-render DOM
interactions.result: Grid style updated, checkmark moves to selected option

interactions.name: term_focus
interactions.action: Stop propagation → read data-term-uuid → fire onFocusTerminal(uuid)
interactions.result: Canvas focuses the already-open terminal card

interactions.name: term_reopen
interactions.action: Stop propagation → read data-term-uuid → fire onReopenTerminal(uuid)
interactions.result: Canvas reopens the previously closed terminal card

interactions.name: theme_toggle
interactions.result: Theme toggled between dark/light, canvas refreshed, editor theme updated, preference saved

states.default: No menu has .open class; all dropdowns hidden
states.menu_open: One .menu-item has .open class; its .menu-dropdown is visible; hover timer may be pending
states.zoom_locked: menu-zoom-lock item shows checkmark (✓) indicating zoom is locked
states.grid_selected: Active grid style item (dots/grid/none) shows checkmark (✓)

dynamic_content.terminal_submenu: Rendered from this.termItems array: 'New' item + separator + per-instance .term-instance entries with data-term-uuid and data-term-open attributes, .is-closed class on closed instances, '(none)' disabled item when array is empty

lifecycle.destroyed_by: Lives for session lifetime; document click handler is cleaned up and replaced on each render()
